title: AGS app refresh result (JSON Lines record)
description: Runtime-owned per-app result/log record for one palette-refresh or restart operation (AD-28/AD-29). The runtime is the sole emitter: one JSON Lines record per app per operation. status is applied, deferred, failed or skipped; deferred/skipped carry a reason; failed carries a reason and a retryable flag. App-internal logs are separate.

runId.description: Runtime operation identity; all app records for one trigger share it.

phase.description: Runtime phase label for the record (AD-28). The runtime, not the app, defines it.

status.description: applied = refresh completed; deferred = accepted but not applied yet; failed = refresh failed; skipped = not invoked because the ledger says it is current.

reason.description: Why the app was deferred, failed or skipped.

retryable.description: Failed only. true means the next trigger retries; false means the failure is terminal for this appearance.

argv.description: Exact argv the runtime invoked; absent for a skipped app.

response.description: Parsed JSON-string response from the app; null when no response was parsed.

timeout.description: true when the 5 s caller timeout expired.

discoveryIndex.description: Ascending discovery order; summary order is by this field (AD-28).
